subject: Social Studies
stem: Guided by his mentor and advisor Chanakya (Kautilya), this ruler overthrew the Nanda dynasty around 321 BCE to found the Mauryan Empire, later expanding it by defeating the Greek general Seleucus Nicator. He was:
explanation: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Mauryan Empire with Chanakya's guidance, later expanding it after defeating Seleucus Nicator (Alexander's successor in the region) — distinct from his grandson Ashoka (who later expanded and then renounced war after Kalinga) and the unrelated Chandragupta II of the later Gupta dynasty.
